audio.strategy: Nearest recorded root at the touch-adjusted velocity. Grand selects v4/v10 at MIDI velocity 70 and Upright switches from L to H above 80. Rhodes uses one recorded dynamic, the original harp sustain loops, velocity-sensitive gain and filtering. Clav, Digital, Misc and the fallback use live synthesis. Organ and Synth use sample-clocked generators in the audio worklet on the piano context.

generatedSources: Live harmonic oscillators and decay envelopes
Sympathetic partials of undamped acoustic strings
Deterministic stereo reverb impulses generated in memory
Organ oscillators, pipe and transistor ranks, seeded key click, shared-age percussion and pitch modulation
Analog and FM oscillators, pulse and noise sources, envelopes, modulation and resonant filters in src/synthesis.ts
notes: 25 roots from MIDI 27 through 99 in minor thirds. The nearest root is transposed at playback. Velocities 1–69 use v4, 70–127 use v10, with continuous per-strike gain scaling.
32 logical voices. At capacity, steal the oldest released voice, then the oldest sustained voice, then the oldest held voice. Stolen voices fade over 15 ms. Ordinary damper release takes 190 ms.
implementationNotes: One model per type. Clav uses a plucked harmonic spectrum, Digital uses a decaying FM attack, and Misc uses a synthesized mallet strike.
String resonance excites a partial of an undamped acoustic string. Each Rhodes root uses its author-specified loop at playback with a decaying envelope.

Twin, JC and Small are waveshaping and cabinet-filter approximations. The shared Rotary uses a crossover, two accelerating motor LFOs, modulated delays and stereo panning. Separate cabinet channels preserve post-rotary fader ownership.
Program tempo supplies the Delay and Mod 1 subdivisions and the Synth LFO and arpeggiator clock. Delay tap chooses the closest time or subdivision.

organ.outputs: Two level-controlled layers mixed into one effect chain. Pipe 1 and Pipe 2 use generated ranks.

synth.outputs: Three independent mono generator outputs enter three effect chains.

surface.panelBehavior: The hardware edits program state, effect chains and performance inputs. Program and Synth displays track the active slot and synth edit page. The program name opens the full-size performance editor.
